title: Community and content platform website
summary: A site where members publish, browse, and engage with content: a public feed, a readable content detail view, member identity, and a creator path alongside the reader path.
defaults: Keep a public browsable feed visible before signup
Make engaging (comment, react, subscribe) the sign-in payoff
Treat reading and creating as two distinct member paths
risks: Content invisible pre-signup with no public feed
No author or member identity on content
Comment and reaction affordances missing from the content view
verification: Browse a public feed without signing up
Open a content detail view and see author identity
Sign up, engage with content, and publish from the creator path
site_goals: Acquire members and creators through join or subscribe
Keep people engaging with feeds, comments, and reactions
Grow content supply through the creator publishing path
